notes: Technical report (arXiv 2607.02770), not a system card. Section 5 (Responsibility, Safety, Security) is qualitative only: no numerical safety, refusal, jailbreak, bias, or dangerous-capability scores. evalResults left empty per pilot safety-only rule. Skipped capability tables (Tables 4–9, 12) including Arena Elo, MMLU Pro, AIME, LiveCodeBench, Codeforces, SciCode, GPQA, BBH, HLE, IFBench, IFEval, MMMLU, MRCR, Terminal Bench, Tau2, vision, audio (CoVoST/FLEURS), and long-context (RULER/LOFT/GraphWalks/MTOB). Bias/Fairness and Misinformation are developer guidance only, not model tests. FSF is cited without domain CCL labels, so riskDecisions empty. contextWindow and languages are not explicitly stated here (only long-context eval lengths up to ~256k). Two-column PDF layout hyphenates many quotes.
